title: Juicy Tunisian Salt Cod Tagine
description: A briny and gooey Tunisian dish featuring salt cod, perfect for a post-workout meal, this kosher-friendly recipe combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with a char-grill twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the soaked and drained salt cod to the pot and stir to coat with the tomato mixture.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
